themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, act as research partners, or assist in complex research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, or otherwise assist in the software coding process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing specific AI platforms, software, or services designed to aid in various aspects of research, from data analysis to insight generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content specifically about AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, research papers, or other information into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is applied to evaluate and improve the usability of products, systems, or interfaces.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is used to gather, analyze, and derive actionable insights from customer data and behavior.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Content that directly compares the features, performance, or effectiveness of different AI tools used for research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussion on how AI is affecting job markets, employment, and the skills required for the future workforce.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles discussing the application of AI in product development, strategy, and management processes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the use of AI chatbots for research, user interaction studies, or the analysis of chatbot performance and behavior.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
